name: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
benefit:
- Financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- per case for treatment.
- Provision of free treatment/surgery for 07 identified heart diseases in children.
- The sanctioned amount is transferred to the account of the concerned medical institution via Cheque or E-Payment (e-transfer).
- The benefit delivery period is stipulated as 20 working days.

***Conditions***

- Treatment must be
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a member of an Economically Weaker Family or a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant must ensure their name is recorded in the family roster and they hold a ration card. - The intended beneficiary (child) must be aged 0 to 15 years. - The intended beneficiary (child) must be suffering from one of the identified heart diseases.
